name: Pembrolizumab (Keytruda)
reasoning: Target: PD-1 immune checkpoint. Modality: anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody (Merck).
Querying ClinicalTrials.gov and PubMed for the pivotal KEYNOTE program and its endpoints…
Cross-checking openFDA + FDA approval summaries for the exact regulatory pathway…
Connecting silos: which indications failed confirmatory trials, and what the regulator actually did about them.
Applying the FDA-precision glossary — accelerated approval ≠ RTOR ≠ Project Orbis; KEYNOTE trials are not FDA programs.

claims.text: Pembrolizumab is the first anti-PD-1 antibody approved in the US (Sept 4, 2014, melanoma), targeting the PD-1 checkpoint.
It sits in a crowded PD-1/PD-L1 class — nivolumab, cemiplimab, dostarlimab, retifanlimab (PD-1); atezolizumab, durvalumab, avelumab (PD-L1).
claims.quote: Antibody drug with a maximum clinical stage of Approval

claims.text: May 23, 2017: first-ever tissue/site-agnostic oncology approval — MSI-H/dMMR solid tumors — based on a biomarker rather than tumor site (accelerated approval; converted to regular March 2023).
claims.quote: the first time that the FDA has approved a cancer treatment for an indication based on a common biomarker rather than the primary site of origin

claims.text: KEYNOTE-361 (1L urothelial, pembrolizumab + chemo) MISSED its dual primary endpoints of OS and PFS (2020-06-09) — an attrition signal in an approved drug's own program.
claims.quote: did not meet … prespecified primary endpoints of overall survival … or progression-free survival

claims.text: KEYNOTE-119 (2L/3L metastatic TNBC, monotherapy) MISSED its primary endpoint of superior overall survival vs chemotherapy (2019-05-20).
claims.quote: did not meet its primary endpoint of overall survival

claims.text: KEYNOTE-240 (2L hepatocellular carcinoma) MISSED its co-primary OS/PFS endpoints despite numerical benefit (2019-02-19).
claims.quote: did not meet its co-primary endpoints of overall survival … and progression-free survival

claims.text: Merck voluntarily WITHDREW the US accelerated approval in small-cell lung cancer (2021-03-01); confirmatory KEYNOTE-604 met PFS but not OS.
claims.quote: voluntarily withdraw the small cell lung cancer indication

claims.text: PRECISION CHECK — at the April 28–29, 2021 ODAC, only SCLC and 3rd-line gastric were withdrawn; the urothelial (5-3) and HCC (8-0) indications were MAINTAINED. Do not claim 'all accelerated indications were withdrawn.'
claims.quote: Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee … accelerated approvals

claims.text: Breadth today: KEYTRUDA spans 20+ tumor types. Concrete anchor — the subcutaneous KEYTRUDA QLEX alone covers 38 FDA-approved indications (approved Sept 19, 2025); IV KEYTRUDA covers still more (it adds hematologic indications QLEX omits). So call it ~40 approved indications as of this run.
